extraction.name: WikiText
extraction.description: A benchmark dataset for language modeling constructed from Wikipedia articles, featuring punctuation, original casing, numbers, and a larger vocabulary to allow for the capture and usage of longer term dependencies.
extraction.creator: Stephen Merity, Caiming Xiong, James Bradbury, Richard Socher
extraction.citeAs: Merity, S., Xiong, C., Bradbury, J., & Socher, R. (2016). Pointer Sentinel Mixture Models. arXiv:1609.07843.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Selected articles fitting the Good or Featured article criteria specified by editors on Wikipedia. The text for each article was extracted using the Wikipedia API.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Extracted raw text from Wikipedia mark-up. Removed specific sections primarily featuring lists. Removed minor bugs such as sort keys and Edit buttons. Replaced mathematical formulae and LATEX code with <formula> tokens. Normalization and tokenization performed using the Moses tokenizer, augmented to split numbers. Constructed vocabulary by discarding words with count below 3; mapped OOV words to <unk> token.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Specific sections primarily featuring lists were removed by default. Mathematical formulae and LATEX code were replaced with <formula> tokens. Only Good or Featured articles were selected.
